items.title: Nepal to seek measures to boost exports during PM’s India visit
items.summary: Kathmandu plans to seek easier access for Nepali products, resolve certification hurdles, review anti-dumping duties on jute goods and expand access to Indian ports.

items.title: Malan’s 71 takes Chitwan to 133 against Sudurpaschim
items.summary: Chitwan Rhinos set the Royals a target of 134 in Qualifier 2, with the winner advancing to the final against Lumbini Lions.

items.title: Top UN court finds Myanmar committed state-sponsored genocide against Muslim Rohingya
items.summary: The International Court of Justice says Myanmar’s military carried out mass killings, rape and village destruction in 2017 with the intent to destroy part of the Rohingya population, in a landmark ruling with implications for other genocide cases.

items.title: Nepal plans to let investors trade rights entitlements on stock exchange
items.summary: The move would permit shareholders unable or unwilling to buy additional shares a chance to earn money from their entitlements instead of letting them go unused.

items.title: Trump, Xi, Putin conclude historic meeting on Ukraine war, nuclear arms
items.summary: The leaders discussed Ukraine, nuclear disarmament and regional conflicts, but deep divisions over security, trade and Taiwan cast doubt on whether the unprecedented meeting would produce concrete agreements.

items.title: Fatal crashes keep claiming lives on Hetauda-Kathmandu road
items.summary: Three people died in Thursday’s jeep crash, a week after a microbus accident killed 14 in Bhimphedi. The 82-km route has seen 30 crashes and 22 deaths this fiscal year alone.

items.title: Nepal and Bangladesh to play historic T20I at Lord’s in June
items.summary: The fixture, which is historic for both the countries, will take place as part of the MCC-hosted Nepal tour to England, where the Rhinos will play against Scotland and Ireland.

items.title: CIB obtains arrest warrant for former chief secretary over Malaysia worker scam
items.summary: Six people, including two former labour ministers, have been arrested over allegations that money collected illegally from Nepali workers was sent to Malaysia.

items.title: ANFA suspension lifted after months of restrictions
items.summary: The National Sports Council reverses its action against the football governing body as Nepal seeks to address concerns raised by international football authorities.

items.title: Bhandari accuses government of targeting political opponents, media
items.summary: Former president Bidya Devi Bhandari says due process and democratic freedoms are being undermined, urging political parties to unite in defence of the constitution.

items.title: Three killed, seven injured in jeep crash in Makawanpur
items.summary: The passenger vehicle veered off the Hetauda-Bhaise road and plunged into a stream early Thursday while travelling from Rautahat to Kathmandu.

items.title: Trump says historic summit with Xi, Putin already a ‘win’ before event
items.summary: A lavish welcome in China sets the stage for talks that analysts say are unlikely to bridge deep divisions over trade, Ukraine and nuclear weapons.

items.title: Chocolate offers a special taste of China, one bite at a time
items.summary: From models of city landmarks to tea-infused treats, businesses are giving a familiar confection a fresh twist.

items.title: Long-awaited Ring Road’s Kalanki-Basundhara section widening yet to take off
items.summary: More than eight years after the project was agreed, work on the 8.2-kilometre stretch has yet to begin as China is still in the process of selecting a contractor.

items.title: Chief removal controversies leave Nepal Police leadership shaky
items.summary: Political interference, legal battles, factional rivalries and frequent changes to service rules have weakened the chain of command, undermined morale and obstructed institutional reform since the restoration of democracy in 1990.
